Official vendor reference subset copied from the user-supplied archive:
  APUG011_high_performance_sdram_read_write_reference_design_v1.2
  Anlogic APUG011 v1.2 (2023-06)

Files in this directory are vendor reference/read-only material.
Do not refactor or edit encrypted vendor cores. Project logic must connect through
src/framebuf/sdram_adapter.v and later board/vendor wrappers.

Included:
  include/global_def.v
  enc_file/sdr_as_ram.enc.v
  enc_file/sdr_init_ref.enc.v
  enc_file/sdr_wrrd.enc.v
  model/IS42s32200.v

Not copied intentionally:
  - reference top/app_wrrd test generator
  - reference PLL project
  - reference ADC/SDC
Those belong to the EG4S-MINI-DEV3 reference project and are not HX4S20C board constraints.

P1-01 does NOT add these encrypted files to FPGA_Competition_HDMI.al yet.
P1-02 will perform explicit TD/vendor-core integration and synthesis checks after
P1-01 ModelSim verification is accepted.

P1-02B addition:
  clk_pll.v
    Exact copy of prj/al_ip/clk_pll.v from the official APUG011 v1.2 archive.
    Official reference only: FIN=25.000 MHz, clk1=150 MHz 0 deg,
    clk2=150 MHz 180 deg. It is used only by p1_apug011_td_top synthesis harness;
    it is NOT the final HX4S20C 50 MHz board PLL.
